purpose: Capture project-specific critical path, critical circuit, demand, and target identity data needed before production-final sizing review.

fieldHints.localLossElementIds: Exact fitting/accessory/equipment ids on the verified HVAC critical path or hydronic critical circuit. Use only after path/circuit review.
fieldHints.criticalPathLocalLossPressurePa: Externally verified total local-loss pressure for the selected critical path/circuit in Pa.
fieldHints.criticalPathLocalLossComplete: Set true only when the local-loss pressure covers the complete selected path/circuit and has been engineer-reviewed.
fieldHints.hvacDuctSizingTargetElementIds: Duct element ids to include in HVAC resize proposals.
fieldHints.hvacDesignFlowsByElementId: Map of duct element id to confirmed design airflow in m3/h.
fieldHints.hvacDefaultDesignFlowM3h: Optional fallback airflow in m3/h for sampled ducts without explicit per-element flow.
fieldHints.hydronicPipeSizingTargetElementIds: Pipe element ids to include in hydronic resize proposals.
fieldHints.hydronicDesignFlowsByElementId: Map of pipe element id to confirmed design flow in L/s.
fieldHints.hydronicDefaultDesignFlowLs: Optional fallback flow in L/s for sampled hydronic pipes without explicit per-element flow.
fieldHints.domesticWaterPipeSizingRequests.elementI: Exact domestic water pipe ElementId targeted for proposal-only resize_pipe handoff.
fieldHints.domesticWaterPipeSizingRequests.fixtureU: Confirmed fixture-unit demand when flowLs is not directly supplied.
fieldHints.domesticWaterPipeSizingRequests.flowLs: Confirmed domestic water design flow in L/s; overrides fixture-unit curve conversion.
fieldHints.sanitaryStormPipeSizingRequests.drainage: Use sanitary for fixture-unit sizing or storm for runoff-flow sizing.
fieldHints.sanitaryStormPipeSizingRequests.runoffFl: Confirmed storm runoff/design flow in L/s; overrides catchment/rainfall calculation.
fieldHints.sanitaryStormPipeSizingRequests.catchmen: Storm catchment area in m2 when runoffFlowLs is not supplied.
fieldHints.firePipeSizingRequests.flowLpm: Confirmed fire demand in L/min; overrides cabinet/sprinkler demand calculation.
fieldHints.firePipeSizingRequests.cabinetCount: Number of fire cabinets served by the target pipe when using office cabinet demand rules.
fieldHints.firePipeSizingRequests.sprinklerDemandLp: Confirmed sprinkler demand contribution in L/min.

modelEvidenceRequired: Exact ElementId and UniqueId for each target duct or pipe.
Current size and length for each target.
Engineer-confirmed design flow or demand basis for each target.
Critical path/circuit element list and total local-loss pressure when production-final HVAC/hydronic sizing is requested.
Fire-engineer approval for fire/sprinkler demand and hydraulic standard before any fire resize commit.
notes: Combine this payload with docs/revit-mep-office-standards-input-template.json after replacing placeholders with approved values.
The analyzeMepSystemArguments object is directly passable after filling arrays/maps; copy optionalScalarArguments into it only after replacing null placeholders with numbers.
Passing this data to analyze_mep_system can produce proposal-only writePlanProposal steps; it is not commit approval.
Any generated write-plan still requires prepare_write_plan, preview_write_plan, explicit approval, commit_write_plan, verify_write_plan, and engineer review.
